item.title: Driver killed after BMW crashes into tree in Sorrento Valley
item.description: A 28-year-old man was killed in a high speed crash in the Sorrento Valley area early Saturday morning, and DUI is suspected to be a factor in the fatal crash.

item.title: 6 things to do in San Diego this weekend
item.description: San Diego has a variety of events happening this weekend, from the opening of Elephant Valley at the San Diego Zoo Safari Park to the 97th Annual Rummage Sale at Balboa Park, as well as the Farm-to-Table Brunch at Coastal Roots Farm, the San Diego Festival of Science & Engineering, and the Baja Birria Pocket Burrito at City Tacos.

item.title: San Diego sailors advised to take extra precautions in public
item.description: Navy sailors in the San Diego area are reportedly being advised to take extra precautions in public, such as changing out of uniform when leaving base, due to heightened military activity.

item.title: Rep. Darrell Issa drops out of congressional race
item.description: Darrell Issa has ended his congressional campaign for California District 48 and endorsed San Diego County Supervisor Jim Desmond to replace him.

item.title: Man arrested on suspicion of luring and inappropriately touching girl, 12, in San Diego
item.description: San Diego police arrested a man suspected of kidnapping and making inappropriate physical contact with a young girl who was walking home from school in the Bay Terraces neighborhood.

item.title: Homicide detectives investigate suspicious death in University City
item.description: An 81-year-old woman was found dead in her bed on Friday evening, and the San Diego Police Department's Homicide Unit is investigating the unusual circumstances surrounding her death.

item.title: PHOTOS: Separate semi-truck incidents stall San Diego freeways four days in a row
item.description: Traffic on San Diego freeways was severely impacted for four days in a row due to separate semi-truck incidents, including a fatal crash, a fire, and an overturned truck, causing major delays and hours-long traffic jams.

item.title: 30 officers arrested for alleged ties to cartels in Baja
item.description: "We have detained more than 30 police officers throughout the state, all had working relationshipos with the Arzate brothers, some also had ties to other criminal groups," said María Elena Andrade Ramírez, Baja's Attorney General.

item.title: Heroic U.S. Marine honored with Navy Ship
item.description: The USNS Hector A. Cafferata Jr. (T-ESB-8), the sixth and final ship in the Navy's Expeditionary Sea Base program, was christened in San Diego, honoring Marine Corps hero Hector A. Cafferata Jr. for his bravery during the Korean War.

item.title: UPDATE: Sheriff's Office finds 7-year-old boy missing in Santee
item.description: The San Diego County Sheriff's Office is searching for a missing 7-year-old boy named Blake, who was last seen near the Santee Sportsplex in Santee, California.
